# India Deep Dive

*Generated by `src/india.py` from the cleaned Kaggle data. Rating and popularity use rated restaurants only; costs in INR and approximate US$ (World Bank 2017 rate).*

India: **8,652 restaurants** in **43 cities** and **841 city-locality pairs**; 6,513 rated. Delhi NCR (New Delhi, Gurgaon, Noida, Faridabad, Ghaziabad) holds 91.9% of them.

Sampling caveat: outside Delhi NCR the file lists only about 20 restaurants per city, and these tend to be well-known ones (see median votes), so city comparisons outside NCR describe a selected sample.
